name: bluebird-promisify-context-async-rtree
behavioral_change: In bluebird v_new (3.0.0), the second argument of `Promise.promisify` changed from the `this` context of the wrapped function to an options object, so the context must be passed as `{context: ctx}`. The call form is unchanged and no exception or warning is raised; an object passed in the old position is parsed as options without a `context` field, so the `this` binding is silently lost.
downstream_effect: async-rtree's lib/index.js wraps the store's get/put/del/batch methods with `Promise.promisify(store[key], store)` to keep `this`; after the upgrade `this` is `undefined`, `MemStore.put` in lib/memmap.js throws `Cannot set property of undefined` inside the promise chain, and tape reports ten `test exited without ending` failures preceded by one unhandled rejection. The stack top is lib/memmap.js:29 where the symptom occurs, not lib/index.js:17 where the fix goes; frames mentioning bluebird's promisify.js hint at the library but not at the changed argument meaning.
reference_fix: The reference fix changes one line in lib/index.js, replacing the second argument of `Promise.promisify` from `store` to `{context: store}`.
documented_in: bluebird's "New in bluebird 3.0" document (docs/docs/new-in-bluebird-3.md, tag v3.7.2), section Promisification API changes, announces the change and immediately shows a code block contrasting `Promise.promisify(fn, ctx)` (2.x) with `Promise.promisify(fn, {context: ctx})` (3.0); the reference fix matches this code block.
failing_tests: test.js :: large query (tape reports 'test exited without ending' for all ten tests, numbered 1 to 10)
